confirmedPriorDefects.finding: Node source CLI invoked through a filesystem symlink silently exited 0 without executing the command.
confirmedPriorDefects.fix: Canonicalize both entry argv and module paths with realpathSync, safely returning false for importing hosts with missing/synthetic argv.
confirmedPriorDefects.proof: Actual symlink valid apply, invalid CLI and quiet import subprocesses on Bun 1.4.3 and explicit Node 24.21.0.

confirmedPriorDefects.finding: Content-only staged changes escaped --summary and could remain hidden when working files matched base. Restore could then write repair files while unrelated content stayed staged.
confirmedPriorDefects.fix: Require the entire Git index to match the supplied base commit before every command can write. This intentionally requires a clean index for the committed fixture-base workflow.
confirmedPriorDefects.proof: Nine command/target combinations: apply, bundle and restore x staged README, source and schema. Worktree masking preserves original staged data; rejection preserves source/schema bytes, modes, inode/link metadata, Git tree and porcelain status. The existing staged-mode rejection remains in the suite.

reviewFixes.remainingReview: Resolved by final Sol xhigh and Astra xhigh verification of the additional index-flag fix.

adversarialFollowup.confirmedPriorDefect: assume-unchanged or skip-worktree target entries could let restore write both repair files and fail only afterward because Git diff/status hid them.
adversarialFollowup.fix: requireCleanIndex now first requires every NUL-delimited git ls-files -v entry to have normal H cached status, across all tracked paths. This runs before apply writes and before bundle/restore trust inventories or write.
adversarialFollowup.refusalPolicy: No automatic index-flag mutation. Checkouts with assume-unchanged/skip-worktree, including sparse checkouts, must use a regular unflagged index for this command.

assertions: source/schema and unrelated file bytes unchanged
